title: The record that survives the session
intro: A handover is the one artifact designed to be read by someone who was not there. It carries the sections the policy requires and no transcript.

scenarios.title: A body with every required section
scenarios.explain: Objective, Current State and Next Action. The front matter — task, branch, head, worktree — is computed, so the body cannot disagree with git about where it was written.

scenarios.title: A body missing a required section
scenarios.explain: The sections are named in the refusal. A handover without a Next Action is the failure mode this record exists to prevent, so it is not accepted and quietly filed.
